t: Styrene-free, vinylester-hybrid, high performance mortar for the most demanding requirements. Extremely durable, universally applicable injection mortar adds optimal strength when used with Fischer new generation universal mortars. Offers versatile fixing use in steel structures, consoles, facades, rescue ladders or cable trays. Ideal for fixings in perforated brick, solid brick, concrete and aerated concrete. The injection mortar system also benefits from system components such as anchor rods, anchors with internal threads, injection anchor sleeves for fixings in concrete, aerated concrete and masonry in both internal and external areas. Can be applied in water-filled boreholes. Fire-rated F120. Supplied with 2 nozzles.
